item.title: Her Boyfriend Said She Fell But Prosecutors Saw Something Else
item.description: Rhonda Casto died after falling more than 150 feet from Oregon’s Eagle Creek Trail in 2009 while hiking with boyfriend Stephen Nichols. Prosecutors later accused Nichols of pushing her, but he ultimately pleaded guilty to criminally negligent homicide and coercion rather than murder.

item.title: Her Disappearance Unraveled After A Man’s Story Fell Apart
item.description: Savannah Spurlock disappeared in Kentucky in 2019 after leaving a bar with several men. Months later, her remains were found on property linked to David Sparks, who had denied knowing what happened. He later pleaded guilty to tampering with evidence and abuse of a corpse.

item.title: The Documentary Brooke Preston’s Family Says Got It Wrong
item.description: Brooke Preston was killed by her roommate Randy Herman Jr. in Florida in 2017. Herman claimed he had been sleepwalking, a defense explored in Hulu’s Dead Asleep. Preston’s family later criticized the documentary as misleading and said it centered too heavily on Herman’s version of events.

item.title: His Brother Has Spent Decades Fighting For Justice
item.description: Nine-month-old Jacob Landin died in New Mexico in 1987 after suffering severe head injuries. His older brother Eric was initially blamed for earlier injuries despite being only six years old. The case remains open, and Eric has spent decades pushing for answers and accountability

item.title: Her Husband’s Story Did Not Match The GPS Evidence
item.description: Lynette Hooker disappeared in the Bahamas in April 2026 after her husband said she fell from their dinghy at night. Investigators later said GPS evidence appeared to conflict with his account, prompting renewed searches and a possible murder investigation. No one has been charged.

item.title: Her Family Did Not Know She Was Missing For Years
item.description: Fawn Marie Mountain was last seen in Claysburg, Pennsylvania, in 2012, but her family did not report her missing until years later. She has never been found, and Pennsylvania State Police continue to investigate her disappearance while offering a reward for information.

item.title: The Bank Robber With A Bomb Locked Around His Neck
item.description: In 2003, pizza delivery driver Brian Wells robbed a bank near Erie, Pennsylvania, with a timed explosive device secured around his neck. Police detained him shortly afterward, but the bomb detonated before it could be removed. Investigators later charged Marjorie Diehl-Armstrong and Kenneth Barnes in the plot.
